environment.description: Deployed identically on ECS Fargate behind an internet-facing ALB. However, the ALB is associated with an AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 0: AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' with all rules in COUNT mode except 'SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING' which is in BLOCK mode (blocks query strings > 2048 bytes); (2) Priority 1: A custom rule group 'inventory-app-sqli-body' that inspects ONLY the request BODY with SqliMatchStatement and action BLOCK; (3) Priority 2: AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet' with override action NONE (meaning individual rule actions apply), which inspects ALL request components including query string parameters, URI path, and headers using the built-in SQLi detection engine. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the SQLiRuleSet triggers on single-quote injection patterns in query parameters.
